intent.raw: Design the governance model and ontology while applying no governance rule and preserving structure without enforcement.
intent.objective: Author one private, no-effect Governance Model Design for an observe-only repository posture and the first assessment vertical.

steps.name: Close product, authority, ontology, historical harm, and repository posture evidence
stop_conditions: Stop if the source boundary cannot distinguish product meaning, authority, evidence, and runtime enforcement.
Stop before editing any existing enforcement or authority surface.

steps.name: Select existing Design and ontology package patterns
stop_conditions: Stop if Inventory would become definition, ontology, or promotion authority.

steps.name: Author six Design views, posture contract, and ontology seed
stop_conditions: Stop if observe-only is described as active.
Stop if ontology records apply a rule, decide authority, or modify product ontology.
Stop before Plan, Work Pack, Task Session, implementation, or enforcement activation.

steps.name: Validate the smallest coherent Design units
stop_conditions: Stop if posture control and rule meaning collapse into one aggregate.
Stop if whole-repository deactivation is claimed without complete surface coverage.

gates.condition: Every Design obligation maps to a current selector or an explicit evidence gap.
The candidate model applies no governance effect; the only companion authority change is the exact CAV2-D58 Definition repair, with no Constitution or validator activation.
Posture substrate and first rule-fitness vertical remain separate coherent units with a recomposition proof.

gates.owner: CyberAlchemy v2 product and authority owners
gates.condition: Owners review the candidate Design and exact surface scope before any Define admission or implementation planning.

technique_overlays.trigger: The user wants to preserve governance structure while removing repository-owned blocking effects.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The Design distinguishes structure, observation, enforcement effect, authority, lifecycle, and owner decision.

boundaries.contract: Observe-only governance cannot control the ordinary work result.
Assessment routes a recommendation but cannot create the owner decision.
External product bindings reference stable product IDs without editing product registries or claiming measured outcomes.

authority.lifecycle: The candidate Design owns only its target directory; the owner-requested definitions repair separately owns exact D58 Definition synchronization surfaces.
authority.execution: No posture installation, adapter execution, governance enforcement, or ontology implementation is authorized.
authority.validation: JSON, path, dispatch, six-view, and claim-ceiling checks only.
authority.evidence: Repository sources, current configuration observations, and one bounded read-only helper receipt.
authority.memory: Inventory is read-only discovery evidence and is not mutated.
authority.promotion: Definitions, constitutions, product ontology, runtime, and public Arcanum owners remain independent.

state_namespaces.write_policy: CAV2-D58 Definition identity and links only; no Constitution activation or rule enforcement.

state_namespaces.namespace: all other repository paths and Git roots not named above

promotion_splits.rule: Design evidence does not install or activate repository posture.
Assessment evidence cannot decide or execute a rule transition.

promotion_splits.target: product proof or product ontology mutation
promotion_splits.rule: External intended-contribution bindings are non-authoritative projections.

promotion_guardrails: No local Governance Model candidate term becomes a canonical definition; the companion CAV2-D58 Constitution repair is separately scoped Definition authority.
No modeled rule becomes a constitution or enforcement rule.
No product binding proves product value.
No private material moves to public Arcanum.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The reusable route does not require delegated execution; one bounded read-only helper was used only to balance the current session's surface map.
subagent_strategy.explanation: The parent owns the Design synthesis and all writes; no reusable multi-agent graph or delegated mutation is proposed.
context: One read-only enforcement-surface audit and one bounded read-only definitions review were joined; neither mutated files.
